test_title: PYST 16: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Tall promises were being made by each candidate.

options.text: Each candidate can make tall promises.
Each candidate has made tall promises.
Each candidate was making tall promises.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Each candidate was making tall promises."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in Past Continuous Tense and in Passive Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Past Continuous Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Object + was/were + being + V3 + by Subject (Passive Voice)__ 
 
• Subject + was/were + v1 + ing + object __(Active Voice)__
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *A song was being sung by Esha.** *(Passive Voice)
 
• *Esha was singing a song. *(Active Voice)​
 
 
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'Tall promises.'​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'each candidate.' 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• 'Were being made' will be changed into 'was making'. 
 
• "Each candidate" is a singular subject so we must "was" with it.
 
• The correct option 4 follows all the above rules and correctly expresses the given sentence in active voice.

42:T
